meta.title: Bike Costa Blanca | Winter cycling house in Ondara, Spain
meta.description: A 3-bedroom townhouse in Ondara, Costa Blanca, built for long winter stays. Ride Coll de Rates, Vall d'Ebo and Bernia from the door. Stays from 11 nights.

hero.title: Your winter cycling base on the Costa Blanca
hero.subtitle: A real house, not a hotel room. Ride the climbs the pro teams train on, come home to a sunny terrace, and stay long enough for the weeks to count.

why.title: While it's dark and wet at home, the season is on here

items.title: Where the pros spend their winter
items.text: From December to February, WorldTour teams base their training camps along this coast. You'll ride the same climbs and probably share a café stop with them.

items.title: Mild, dry riding days
items.text: Average daytime highs sit around 17–21°C from November to April. Shorts and arm warmers on the climbs, sunglasses all day.

items.title: Quiet roads from the door
items.text: Ondara sits between the Mediterranean and the mountains. Within a few kilometres you're on calm inland roads through orange groves and empty valleys.

items.title: An hour from the airport
items.text: Alicante and Valencia airports are both about 100 km away, almost all of it on the AP-7 motorway.

routes.title: Three classic loops, all starting from the house
routes.intro: These are the loops I ride most often. Every route starts and finishes at the front door, and each one is on Strava so you can load it straight onto your computer.

items.name: Coll de Rates
items.imageAlt: Cyclist climbing the Coll de Rates through a pale mountain landscape
items.text: The Costa Blanca's signature climb and the benchmark of every winter camp. Smooth tarmac, a steady gradient and long views back to the sea. Save something for the ride home: the climb is only part of a big day.

items.name: Vall d'Ebo
items.imageAlt: A quiet road winding through the green mountains of Vall d'Ebo
items.text: North through the Pego valley, then inland to Vall d'Ebo. Quiet roads, mountain walls and almost no traffic. Enough climbing to feel earned without turning the day into a test.

items.name: Ondara–Bernia Loop
items.text: A full loop towards the Sierra de Bernia, with views over Calpe and the Peñón de Ifach. The descent is the highlight, with steep sections and tight hairpins, so take extra care.

challenge.title: The Coll de Rates challenge
challenge.text: Tadej Pogačar's time on the climb: 11:57. Mine: 19:20. Ride it during your stay and tell me yours.

house.title: A townhouse with a private terrace, made for living in
house.text: The whole house is yours: three bedrooms, three shower rooms plus a guest WC, and a large private terrace for breakfast in the sun and dinner after a long ride. It's comfortable for a couple who want space or a small group of friends who all ride.
house.imageAlt: Bright dining area inside the house

longStay.title: Stay two weeks. Or the whole winter.
longStay.text: The house is only let for 11 nights or more, because it works best when you settle in. Ride in the morning, work or rest in the afternoon, shop at the market like a local. Longer stays get a better nightly rate.

points.title: Weekly discount
points.text: Applied automatically on Airbnb for every stay.

points.title: Electricity included
points.text: For stays of a month or more, normal use is included (€3.33 per night allowance).

points.title: Everything nearby
points.text: Ondara's shops, cafés and the La Marina shopping centre are minutes away.

longStay.priceNote: From around €70 a night on a two-week winter stay, all fees included. Pick your dates below to see the live price.

explore.title: A great cycling base, even if not everyone in your group rides

items.title: Beaches and coves
items.text: Dénia's long sandy beaches and the rocky coves of Jávea are a short drive away, and they're quiet out of season.

items.title: Towns and villages
items.text: Altea's white old town, Calpe under the Peñón de Ifach, hilltop villages like Alcalalí and the weekly markets.

items.title: Hiking
items.text: Montgó Natural Park and the valley trails around Vall de Gallinera and Vall de Laguar.

items.title: Seasons and festivals
items.text: Almond blossom in January and February, carnival in Pego, Fallas in Dénia in March and orange blossom in spring.

partners.title: Bikes, parts and transfers
partners.text: We don't rent bikes, repair bikes or run tours. We point you to the people we use ourselves.

items.name: Maxima Bikes, Ondara
items.text: Our local shop: servicing, bike and e-bike rental, parts and nutrition.

items.name: Xabia's Bike, Dénia
items.text: Official Specialized dealer and service centre with 25+ years in the Marina Alta. Workshop, rental and kit.

items.name: transfer4u.es
items.text: Airport transfers with room for bike boxes.

items.title: Alicante (ALC)
items.text: About 104 km, roughly an hour on the AP-7.

items.title: Valencia (VLC)
items.text: About 111 km, also mostly on the AP-7.

items.title: Car or transfer
items.text: Hire a car at either airport (book ahead in winter), or use a bike-friendly transfer.

items.title: Bring or rent a bike
items.text: Fly with your own bike, or rent a road or e-bike locally from Maxima Bikes.

host.title: Hi, I'm Eugene
host.text: I ride these roads every week, and I set up this house as the base I'd want for a cycling winter: room for the bike, fast internet, and routes that start at the door. Ask me about routes, cafés or which climb to save for your last day.

items.a: 11 nights. The house is set up for longer stays, from two weeks to the whole winter.
Pick your dates below and you'll go straight to the Airbnb listing with your dates and guests filled in. Airbnb handles the payment and protects your booking.

items.q: Is the house only for cyclists?
items.a: No. Cycling is why the location works so well, but the coast, villages, markets and mild weather make it a good winter base for everyone in your group.

items.q: Do you rent bikes or offer guided rides?
items.a: No. We share our routes and local knowledge, and recommend local shops for rental and servicing.
Yes. There's 302 Mbps Wi-Fi and a dedicated workspace.

items.q: When is the best time for cycling?
items.a: October to May. December to February is the pro training season, and March and April bring longer days and orange blossom.
